description: The FLOT, phase lines and sets of control measures as the web works them out. Screen points are CSS pixels with y down; numbers to a billionth, a line's length to a millionth of a km. scallopRuns(pixels, {diameter = 18, flipped, within}) is the runs of points each unbroken stretch of scallops is drawn through (each run's first point, then 8 points per semicircle), right of the way drawn unless flipped; flotLabelSpot is the line's middle and the unit vector away from its scallops; phaseLineEnds the two ends each with the unit vector out of the line; labelShift how far a label's middle is from its end in halves of its width and height. cleanPhaseLineName: trim, capitals, white space single, a leading PL taken, cut to 24 code points and trimmed again. Inputs that are undefined are written as null with "undefined": true.
